$comment: Hand-written source of truth. scripts/sync-github.mjs merges live GitHub facts (stars, latest release, topics, license, pushedAt) into content/generated/registry.json — it never writes back here.

zh.lede: 用 DreamShaderLang 写虚幻材质。保存即编译成 UMaterial、材质函数、材质层与层混合，默认在内存中生成——不落 .uasset，内容浏览器里干干净净，Cook 时自动实体化。

facts.v: .dsm 材质实现 / .dsf 材质函数 / .dsh 共享头
UMaterial · UMaterialFunction · Material Layer · Layer Blend
9 个官方包，外加从 Cycles 内核移植来的 Blender 着色节点

en.lede: Author Unreal materials in DreamShaderLang. Saving compiles them into UMaterial, material functions, layers and layer blends — built in memory by default, so nothing lands in the Content Browser until a cook materialises it.

facts.v: UMaterial · UMaterialFunction · Material Layer · Layer Blend
9 official packages, plus Blender's shader nodes ported from the Cycles kernel

zh.lede: 把 Niagara 特效写成文本。.dfs / .dfe / .dfm 编译成标准 NiagaraSystem，而任意现有的 NiagaraSystem 也能反编译回源码——往返字节级一致，所以它能接管你已有的特效资产，而不是只能从零开始。

facts.v: .dfs 系统 / .dfe 发射器 / .dfm 模块
编译与反编译字节级幂等，四层校验
原版 UE 5.8，不需要引擎改动

en.lede: Author Niagara VFX as text. .dfs / .dfe / .dfm compile to standard NiagaraSystems, and any existing NiagaraSystem decompiles back to source — byte-idempotent, so it can take over the effects you already have.

zh.lede: 基于 ComfyUI + Vue 的 PBR / NPR 贴图生成工作流。从一张参考图产出成套通道贴图，直接接进上面两条链路——材质引用它，特效也引用它。

facts.v: ComfyUI 工作流 + Vue 操作前端
BaseColor · Normal · Roughness · AO 等通道
PBR 写实与 NPR 卡通两套管线

en.lede: A PBR / NPR texture pipeline built on ComfyUI + Vue. One reference image in, a full channel set out — feeding straight into the two toolchains above.

BaseColor · Normal · Roughness · AO and more
